import pandas as pd

# Source file path
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/training_0.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation:
# Target schema: ['V_GENE']
# Source schema: ['J_CALL']
# The target column V_GENE corresponds to the part of J_CALL before the '*'
# Extract the substring before '*' in J_CALL to create V_GENE

df_target = pd.DataFrame()
df_target['V_GENE'] = df_source0['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

# Save the transformed data to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
